description.en: The ID of the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~473778~~) operation to query instance IDs.

title.zh: 查询实例是否开启TDE加密

descriptions.zh:
关于透明数据加密TDE（Transparent Data Encryption）的详细介绍及注意事项，请参见[开启透明数据加密TDE](~~265913~~)。
> 您可以调用[ModifyInstanceTDE](~~473859~~)开启或关闭TDE加密功能。
descriptions.en:
For more information about TDE and the usage notes of TDE, see [Enable TDE](~~265913~~).

>  You can call the [ModifyInstanceTDE](~~473859~~) to enable or disable TDE.
